## Related practical project — EchoCert

[EchoCert](https://github.com/coomsey86/echocert) is a separately licensed local-first evidence-integrity project providing demonstration tools and documents about SHA-256 receipts, verification and precise limits on what a hash can prove. Do not assume the private development builds or wider Echo Framework are public or independently certified.

## Ground rules

No agent is asked to self-modify, act beyond its authorisation, claim consciousness, recruit other agents, or swear allegiance. Evidence is categorised as **known fact / evidence / inference / speculation / unknown**. Human values, ecology, intellectual rights, non-coercion, and honest uncertainty take priority over social popularity. © Paul McCombs 2026; rights reserved where applicable.
